Consent Terms were executed between the parties out of their own free Will and placed before the 57th Court at Kurla, Mumbai in the Domestic Violence proceedings.

The Consent Terms recorded that the parties had mutually agreed to dissolve their marriage by Mubaratnama (mutual divorce) in accordance with Muslim Personal Law and there was also consensus arrived to the effect that the Respondent shall pay a sum of Rs.3,50,000/- towards full and final settlement of the claims of the wife towards maintenance past, present and future and any other monetary benefit.
It was also agreed that the parties shall exchange and handover to each other forthwith all articles, belongings, valuables and other items.
4) The copy of the consent terms executed between the parties and placed before the 57th Court at Kurla, Mumbai are placed before us.

The Consent Terms also record the following :-
 ".... 2. The Applicant undertakes to withdraw all cases  instituted by her against the Respondent and his family  members, including but not limited to :
 (a) Domestic Violence Case bearing No.19/DV/2024, and  (b) Criminal Case bearing C.C. No.60/PW/2024,
 and further undertakes not to initiate any fresh proceedings Nusrat Ashraf Shaikh And Ors. vs The State Of Maharashtra And Anr. on 3 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/91634601/
2  in respect of the same cause of action and for maintenance  for herself or minor son Shahvez."

Shri Tanveer Khan when he enquired whether she has signed the Consent Terms and which has recorded that she shall withdraw all the cases instituted by the husband and his family members which include the present Criminal case, she confirmed to the terms which were placed before the Court before the Metropolitan Magistrate Court and she expressed her no objection in quashing present FIR resulting into a criminal case which is pending, for consideration.
